description: When someone clicks a fake link, loses an account or gets scammed online, generic advice is not enough — they need the exact steps and the real reporting channels for their country. Digital Compass provides curated crisis playbooks (what to do NOW, what NOT to do, how to report) and prevention guides in 9 languages (Romanian original; English/Hungarian anchored in Romania; Polish, Czech, Slovak, Italian, French, German anchored in their own countries with local authorities: police, CERT, consumer protection). Every playbook exposes its last-verified date. Free, no account, no ads; content licensed CC BY 4.0.

defaultPrompt: Am dat click pe un link de phishing, ce fac acum?
